component.name: lljson
component.summary: Compare and format JSON side by side

description.p: lljson is a native JSON tool that combines a semantic diff, a side-by-side visual comparison and formatting utilities. It works offline, starts instantly and stays smooth with files of a million nodes.

ul.li: Semantic diff: ignores key order and whitespace, and flags type changes such as "1" versus 1
Side-by-side view with synchronized scrolling, aligned rows and highlighted values
Arrays compared by index or by a key such as id, and configurable ignored paths
Jump between differences with keyboard shortcuts and collapse equal sections
Tolerant mode for trailing commas and comments, with clear line and column errors
Format, minify and sort keys, and copy the path or value of any node
Follows the light and dark system theme
